commandEffect: Merge only the existing PR's new HTML page into deployment main with linear history. Do not delete the branch or update any mirror. A main merge does not trigger the tag-based site deployment workflow.
beforeExecution: Recheck the PR diff, head, base and checks. Abort on unexpected changes. --match-head-commit pins the approved PR head.
afterExecution: Verify PR merged, main contains the exact policy blob, and no extra files changed. Existing live tag site-v1.0.4 remains valid; no new deploy is needed solely to preserve the policy in main.
